title: Classic Papers from the history of Chemistry
author: Ancient
content:
Classic Papers from the History of Chemistry
(and Some Physics too)

"Reading all the good books is like a conversation with the finest men of past centuries."  --  René Descartes

Return to Main Menu

Carmen Giunta and I keep each other informed of our parallel work in posting classic chemistry papers. 
His classic papers page
 has additional papers to the ones on this site. His site is  thematically organized and links back to the papers posted here. I intend to continue posting the papers I transcribe in a more-or-less chronological order.

Carmen's top page
 has additional history of chemistry information and links. I recommend you give his site a visit.

You may also be interested in my 
Chemists' Photo Gallery.
